label: Water utility
description: A city or regional drinking-water utility: treatment plants with chemical feed (chlorine, sodium hydroxide, fluoride), filters and clearwells, pump and booster stations, storage tanks and pressure zones, SCADA/HMI with PLCs, RTUs and telemetry, LIMS, billing/CIS and AMI meters, and the regulators and public notices (boil-water, do-not-drink) that go with them. Plans: the AWIA Risk and Resilience Assessment and Emergency Response Plan (SDWA 1433), Tier 1 public notice within 24 hours (40 CFR 141.202).

vocabulary.facility: the water system (treatment plants, pump stations, tanks and the distribution network)
vocabulary.frontline: plant operators, distribution crews, SCADA technicians, lab analysts, meter technicians, customer-service agents
vocabulary.operationsCenter: the treatment plant control room and the utility's operations center

it: AMI head-end and meter data management
customer portal, payments and IVR call center
ot: PLCs at the plant and RTUs at remote sites
PACS and CCTV at tanks and pump stations
small integrated HMI/PLCs at booster stations

roles.name: Director of Water Operations (Incident Commander)
roles.description: Owns the plants, the distribution system and the operators.

roles.name: SCADA / IT Security Manager (Technical Lead)
roles.description: Owns the control system, remote access, the business network and the investigation.

roles.name: Public Information Officer
roles.description: Owns customer notices, boil-water advisories, social media and the press.

roles.name: Water Quality Manager (Compliance)
roles.description: Owns sampling, the lab, regulatory reporting and public-notice triggers.

roles.name: Security & Emergency Manager
roles.description: Owns site security, the law-enforcement liaison and the emergency response plan.

roles.name: Water Treatment Plant Superintendent (Chief Operator)
roles.description: Owns manual operation, treatment-train shutdowns and whether finished water leaves the plant.

roles.name: Distribution Superintendent
roles.description: Owns valve isolation, flushing, main breaks and pressure zones.

roles.name: Customer Service Manager
roles.description: Owns call-center scripts, billing workarounds and the critical-customer list.

outsideParties: EPA (Region office and the Water Security Division)
the county or state health department
the SCADA integrator and chemical suppliers
the city council and the mayor's office
the cyber insurer and breach coach
mediaChannels: customer posts on Facebook and Nextdoor about water taste, smell or color
the utility's own outage and advisory alerts
